title: Ireland expects that every man this day will do his duty.
html_source:
Ironic variation on the famous signal sent by Admiral Horatio Nelson just before the Battle of Trafalgar (1805): “England expects that every man will do his duty.”

PROPOSED SUGGESTION: Would be worth mentioning that Nelson’s Pillar, a monument to him, stood literally at the centre of Dublin, where O'Connell Street meets Henry Street, where the modern-day Millennium Spire stands.
